lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr₂Fe₄O₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 14-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors at about 1.90 Å, while Sr centers show eight O neighbors at roughly 2.65–2.67 Å. O environments are six-coordinate, surrounded by two Fe and four Sr neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Fe octahedra sharing corners, with additional corner and face sharing between Fe octahedra and Sr 8-vertex polyhedra.
